description: This Java class 'CenterReadPlatformServiceImpl' implements the 'CenterReadPlatformService' interface and provides methods for retrieving and managing 'Center' data in a financial or microfinance context. It includes functions to fetch paginated lists of centers, retrieve specific centers, generate templates, and associated group data, among others. The class interacts with a database via JDBC, constructs SQL queries, maps result sets to data objects, and validates search parameters.

classes.name: CenterDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL ResultSet rows to CenterData objects for general retrieval.

classes.name: CenterCalendarDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL ResultSet rows to CenterData objects with calendar and repayment schedule details.

classes.name: GroupDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL ResultSet rows to GroupGeneralData objects for associated group data.

methods.name: retrievePagedAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of CenterData objects based on search parameters and pagination settings.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of CenterData objects based on search parameters without pagination.

methods.name: retrieveAllForDropdown
methods.description: Retrieves a list of centers suitable for populating dropdowns, filtered by officeId.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template CenterData object with default values and options for creating new centers.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed CenterData for a specific center by ID.

methods.name: retrieveCenterGroupTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating a group associated with a specific center.

methods.name: retrieveAssociatedGroups
methods.description: Retrieves groups associated with a specific center.

methods.name: retrieveCenterWithClosureReasons
methods.description: Retrieves a CenterData object including possible closure reasons.

methods.name: retriveAllCentersByMeetingDate
methods.description: Retrieves centers scheduled for meetings on a specific date, optionally filtered by staff.

methods.name: validateForGenerateCollectionSheet
methods.description: Validates staff ID input for generating a collection sheet; throws exception if validation fails.
